title: I Left the Sticky on the Staff-Lounge Toaster That Only Burned My Bagel

parts.text: I loaded the toaster at 8:11 a.m. and only my bagel sat through a six-minute scorch. Tess from legal ran hers two minutes later and it popped gold at two. I was twenty-seven, analyst, standing in a lounge that made me look like I owned the wait. I opened the crumb tray. Mine was the dark slot she never rotated; Tess's side had the liner she swapped since May. I left a sticky: ROTATE FOR EVERYONE, NOT THE FAVORITE. Tess laughed, then her next bagel sulked because I had actually run the clean she postponed. Facilities laminated my sticky. Tess rotate-dates the tray. The toaster finally knows more than one name.

social.video_title: The toaster had a favorite legal slot — Part 1/1
social.description: Six-minute scorches, two-minute gold for legal, a May liner. The sticky got laminated. Has an appliance ever skipped only you?
